title: 第十五章王家来袭苏家之危第十六章城主李北叶的选择
content_zh:
此刻，王府外。
一队人马正骑着几头妖兽，在王府门前。
而王朗和王依依也在门前笑脸欢送，无比恭敬。
“三皇子殿下一路小心，若有什么招待不周的地方，还请三皇子殿下莫要怪罪。”王朗站在一头五品妖兽，烈焰马身旁行礼低头道。
“王家主不必如此，本皇子也只是来转告我父皇的旨意。不管如何，本皇子也希望日后王家能够成为我大夏皇朝的一大助力，也希望依依小姐，能够在望月宗里一鸣惊人。”三皇子依旧面带微笑道。
“承蒙三皇子殿下赞言，依依定将努力修行。”王依依倒也稍作感谢道。
“那就如此吧，本皇子就先行离去。”
说罢，三皇子便带着一干随从，骑着妖兽朝着叶北城外离去。
看着三皇子等人离去的背影，王朗的神情倒是有些严肃起来，毕竟是自己违背了夏皇的意愿，若是真惹夏皇不满，后果也颇为严重。
如今之计，也只能抱好望月宗这条大腿了。
待三皇子等人彻底离开叶北城后，王朗才带着王府之人进入府中。
不远处，苏家大厅内。
“启禀家主，三皇子殿下已经离开了城中。望月宗那位长老也许久未曾现身。”一位苏家高手正看着眼前的苏北楼，跪地禀告道。
苏北楼最近有些憔悴，脸色比三天前要苍老许多。
“知道了，你派人继续盯紧王家，若是有任何风吹草动，一定要第一时间禀告我。”苏北楼摆摆手，语气颇为不耐烦道。
“是！属下遵命。”
苏家高手应声后，瞬间离去。
“父亲，你何必如此焦虑？依儿看，这王家未必会对我们苏家动手。好歹当年也是我们帮助他王朗，将苏阳父母驱赶出了苏家，难道他王朗会背信弃义不成？”就在这时，一道身影出现在苏北楼身边道。
此人极为年轻，看起来不过二十出头。
披肩的黑发之下，长着一张极为俊俏的脸庞，神情带着一丝傲气，似乎并不惧怕王家。

他就是苏家现任少主，也是苏北楼的亲儿子，苏少锋！
见自己的儿子出声，苏北楼不由苦笑道：“少锋，你还是太年轻了，如今王家的势力早已在我苏家之上，特别是王家那位千金，如今更是踏入了神武境，加上背后有大夏皇朝以及望月宗的支持，你以为我们苏家还会被他王朗放在眼里吗？哪怕再加上城主府，恐怕他王朗也不会有丝毫害怕吧。”
此言一出，苏少锋的神情也不由难看起来。
他虽二十出头，也有着三玄境圆满的修为，但从未想过苏家有朝一日会灭在王家手上，当年苏阳作为他的表弟，风头便一直盖过他。.
本以为苏阳消失后，自己能够取而代之成为叶北城的天之骄子。
谁曾想，王依依居然会在他之前踏入神武境，这让一向自傲的苏少锋心中十分不服气。
在他看来，自己才是苏家最强的少主，是叶北城最耀眼的那颗星。
“哼！他王朗要是真敢对我们苏家出手，我苏少锋就算死，也要咬下他身上的一块肉。”苏少锋倒是紧捏拳头道。
content_en:
At this moment, outside the palace.
A group of men and horses were riding several monster beasts in front of the palace gate.
Wang Lang and Wang Yiyi also bid farewell with smiles and were extremely respectful in front of the door.
"Your Highness, the Third Prince, be careful along the way. If there is any lack of hospitality, please do not blame His Highness the Third Prince." Wang Lang stood next to a fifth-grade monster beast, the Flame Horse, and bowed his head and said.
"Master Wang, you don't have to be like this. This prince is just here to convey my father's will. No matter what, I also hope that the Wang family can become a major support to our Great Xia Dynasty in the future, and I also hope that Miss Yiyi can become a success in Wangyue Sect." The third prince said with a smile still on his face.
"Thanks to His Highness the Third Prince's praise, Yiyi will work hard to practice." Wang Yiyi also thanked him a little.
"That's it, I, the prince, will leave first."
After saying that, the third prince took his entourage and rode the monster beast towards the outside of Yebei City.
Seeing the third prince and others leaving, Wang Lang's expression became a little serious. After all, he had violated Emperor Xia's wishes. If he really dissatisfied Emperor Xia, the consequences would be quite serious.
The only plan now is to embrace the hope of Wangyue Sect.
After the third prince and others completely left Ye Beicheng, Wang Lang entered the mansion with the people from the palace.
Not far away, in the Su family hall.
"I would like to report to the head of the family that His Highness the Third Prince has left the city. The elder of Wangyue Sect may not have appeared for a long time." A master of the Su family was looking at the Su Bei Tower in front of him and knelt down to report.
Su Beilou has been looking a little haggard recently, and his face looks much older than three days ago.
"I know, you send people to keep an eye on the Wang family. If there is any trouble, you must report it to me as soon as possible." Su Beilou waved his hand and said in a rather impatient tone.
"Yes! I obey my orders."
The Su family master responded and left instantly.
"Father, why are you so anxious? From my perspective, the Wang family may not take action against our Su family. At any rate, we were the ones who helped him Wang Lang and drove Su Yang's parents out of the Su family. Could it be that Wang Lang would break his promise?" At this moment, a figure appeared next to Su Beilou and asked.
This man was extremely young, looking to be in his early twenties.
Under the shawl of black hair, he has a very handsome face, with a hint of arrogance in his expression, and he seems not to be afraid of the Wang family.
He is the current young master of the Su family and the biological son of Su Beilou, Su Shaofeng!
Seeing his son speaking out, Su Beilou couldn't help but smile bitterly and said: "Shaofeng, you are still too young. Now the power of the Wang family has already surpassed that of my Su family, especially the daughter of the Wang family, who has now stepped into the divine martial realm. With the support of the Great Xia Dynasty and the Wangyue Sect behind us, do you think our Su family will still be taken seriously by Wang Lang? Even if the City Lord's Palace is added, I am afraid that Wang Lang will not be afraid at all."
As soon as he said this, Su Shaofeng couldn't help but look embarrassed.
Although he was in his early twenties and had perfect cultivation in the Three Mysteries Realm, he never thought that the Su family would one day be destroyed by the Wang family. As his cousin, Su Yang had always overshadowed him. .
I thought that after Su Yang disappeared, I could take his place and become Ye Beicheng's favored son.
Who would have thought that Wang Yiyi would step into the divine martial realm before him, which made Su Shaofeng, who had always been proud, very unconvinced.
In his opinion, he is the strongest young master of the Su family and the most dazzling star in Ye Beicheng.
"Hmph! If Wang Lang really dares to attack our Su family, I, Su Shaofeng, will bite off a piece of his body even if I die." Su Shaofeng clenched his fists and said.
